findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: delivery_check, check_email_auth, check_dns_records, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: launch_score, check_dns_records, lookup_domain_registration · Public sink: launch_score, check_email_auth, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: delivery_check, check_email_auth, check_dns_records, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: launch_score, check_dns_records, lookup_domain_registration · Public sink: launch_score, check_email_auth, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
